title: To Date A Predator
description:
TDAP is a Novel-like fanfiction, a highly ambitious AU of the Zootopian world, with nuanced layers of societal and cultural commentary, focusing on inclusion. The first movie's plot remains largely intact, as do the main characters and their personalities and backstories...

But! a savage light—somewhat comparable to Beastars—shines on everything: the instinct-driven dynamic between Predators and Prey remains nearly as fierce as in olden times and governs daily interaction and societal conduct. No systemic racism; distancing out of mutual fear and choice.

A mix of literary fiction, dark-ish dystopia, eventual romance, and complex cultures à la Robert Jordan, TDAP focuses on Judy Hopps' and Nick Wilde's psychologies/ambitions as they navigate the dystopian city of Zootopia after the Nighthowler case and the much, much more meaningful pit incident—the by-now century-long experiment of the only city on Animalia where sentient Predator and Prey—and their inextricable cultures—coexist and paws-on research for inclusion is done.
author: FurFanatic
